description:
Prior and successor versions of one provision across consolidations — how the text got to its current form.

Lexiara Nexus data requires an API key on a signed-in account. The free plan carries a monthly Nexus allowance; the legislative text itself is always free.

eId.description: Provision identifier: 'sec_4' (section 4), 'art_2__para_1' (article 2(1)), 'sch_9' (Schedule 9). Use search or history endpoints to discover eIds.

work.description: ELI URI of the instrument, e.g. 'http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1994/23' (UK VAT Act 1994) or 'http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/2006/112/oj' (EU VAT Directive).

name: provision_history

outputSchema.description: The JSON response from the corresponding Lexiara API route.

title: A provision's version history
